english.description: Richard Hannay is living in London, England. He yearns for a more interesting life.
english.name: EVENT_01_THE_WRONG_DITCH

english.description: Resolved to leave England for the Cape, Hannay's outlook changes as a mysterious visitor drops by.
english.name: EVENT_02_AN_UNLIKELY_VISIT

english.description: Scudder has confided in Hannay, but he is not out of danger. Officially dead, he must now lie low.
english.name: EVENT_03_DEEPER_IN_THIS_MESS

english.description: The murder of the American spy suggests he wasn't talking hot air. But everything points to Hannay as the killer.
english.name: EVENT_04_IN_THE_SOUP

english.description: Wanted by the police for murder, and by the real killers for knowing too much, Hannay must flee London.
english.name: EVENT_05_THIRD_CLASS_CITIZEN

english.description: With a considerable distance between himself and his pursuers, Hannay makes his next move.
english.name: EVENT_06_SANCTUARY_OF_THE_INN

english.description: Having decoded Scudder's book, Hannay now has all the facts - if only he can remain hidden until the second week of June.
english.name: EVENT_07_A_PACK_OF_LIES

english.description: Sir Harry's pickle turns out to Hannay's advantage as he makes friends in high places.
english.name: EVENT_08_THE_RADICAL_CANDIDATE

english.description: Hannay must lie low. But the Scottish police are pursuing him, with an advantage on their home turf.
english.name: EVENT_09_RUN_TO_THE_HILLS

english.description: As a bespectacled roadman, Hannay comes face to face with his enemies in a grueling battle of wits.
english.name: EVENT_10_THE_ROADMAN

english.description: Things are looking desperate for Hannay, as his pursuers gain the upper hand. Running is the only option.
english.name: EVENT_11_THE_GAME_IS_UP

english.description: In the jaws of the enemy, Hannay's fate appears sealed. The clock is ticking against Hannay and Great Britain.
english.name: EVENT_12_DESPERATE_MEASURES

english.description: Damaged and intoxicated, Hannay escapes the clutches of the Black Stone, but they know he is nearby.
english.name: EVENT_13_DOWNWARD_SPIRAL

english.description: Turnbull's nursing brings Hannay back to fighting fitness. But time is running out as June 15 draws near.
english.name: EVENT_14_DRY_FLY_FISHERMAN

english.description: Sir Walter Bullivant takes Hannay at his word, but fears Scudder's findings may have been a little off track.
english.name: EVENT_15_GRAVE_NEWS

english.description: The Foreign Office's meeting with Royer is brought forward in a bid to derail the Black Stone's plot.
english.name: EVENT_16_THE_BLACK_STONE

english.description: All seems lost. But could Scudder's pocket book hold the secret to the Black Stone's whereabouts?
english.name: EVENT_17_THE_THIRTY_NINE_STEPS

english.description: Hannay is confident he has the right place, but doubts begin to surface when he sees the target.
english.name: EVENT_18_MASTERS_OF_DISGUISE

english.description: Could Hannay have got it all wrong? The final stand will reveal all.
english.name: EVENT_19_HIGH_TIDES

english.description: You now know the secrets of the deadly Black Stone and The Thirty-Nine Steps!
english.name: EVENTS_COMPLETED

schinese.description: Richard Hannay is living in London, England. He yearns for a more interesting life.
schinese.name: EVENT_01_THE_WRONG_DITCH

schinese.description: Resolved to leave England for the Cape, Hannay's outlook changes as a mysterious visitor drops by.
schinese.name: EVENT_02_AN_UNLIKELY_VISIT

schinese.description: Scudder has confided in Hannay, but he is not out of danger. Officially dead, he must now lie low.
schinese.name: EVENT_03_DEEPER_IN_THIS_MESS

schinese.description: The murder of the American spy suggests he wasn't talking hot air. But everything points to Hannay as the killer.
schinese.name: EVENT_04_IN_THE_SOUP

schinese.description: Wanted by the police for murder, and by the real killers for knowing too much, Hannay must flee London.
schinese.name: EVENT_05_THIRD_CLASS_CITIZEN

schinese.description: With a considerable distance between himself and his pursuers, Hannay makes his next move.
schinese.name: EVENT_06_SANCTUARY_OF_THE_INN

schinese.description: Having decoded Scudder's book, Hannay now has all the facts - if only he can remain hidden until the second week of June.
schinese.name: EVENT_07_A_PACK_OF_LIES

schinese.description: Sir Harry's pickle turns out to Hannay's advantage as he makes friends in high places.
schinese.name: EVENT_08_THE_RADICAL_CANDIDATE

schinese.description: Hannay must lie low. But the Scottish police are pursuing him, with an advantage on their home turf.
schinese.name: EVENT_09_RUN_TO_THE_HILLS

schinese.description: As a bespectacled roadman, Hannay comes face to face with his enemies in a grueling battle of wits.
schinese.name: EVENT_10_THE_ROADMAN

schinese.description: Things are looking desperate for Hannay, as his pursuers gain the upper hand. Running is the only option.
schinese.name: EVENT_11_THE_GAME_IS_UP

schinese.description: In the jaws of the enemy, Hannay's fate appears sealed. The clock is ticking against Hannay and Great Britain.
schinese.name: EVENT_12_DESPERATE_MEASURES

schinese.description: Damaged and intoxicated, Hannay escapes the clutches of the Black Stone, but they know he is nearby.
schinese.name: EVENT_13_DOWNWARD_SPIRAL

schinese.description: Turnbull's nursing brings Hannay back to fighting fitness. But time is running out as June 15 draws near.
schinese.name: EVENT_14_DRY_FLY_FISHERMAN

schinese.description: Sir Walter Bullivant takes Hannay at his word, but fears Scudder's findings may have been a little off track.
schinese.name: EVENT_15_GRAVE_NEWS

schinese.description: The Foreign Office's meeting with Royer is brought forward in a bid to derail the Black Stone's plot.
schinese.name: EVENT_16_THE_BLACK_STONE

schinese.description: All seems lost. But could Scudder's pocket book hold the secret to the Black Stone's whereabouts?
schinese.name: EVENT_17_THE_THIRTY_NINE_STEPS

schinese.description: Hannay is confident he has the right place, but doubts begin to surface when he sees the target.
schinese.name: EVENT_18_MASTERS_OF_DISGUISE

schinese.description: Could Hannay have got it all wrong? The final stand will reveal all.
schinese.name: EVENT_19_HIGH_TIDES

schinese.description: You now know the secrets of the deadly Black Stone and The Thirty-Nine Steps!

schinese.description: 弱小灵魂与神秘面甲融合，这是永恒的开端，一切不同的源头：意识强度达到10以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_MianJuLevel_10

schinese.description: 面甲反哺的古老神秘知识使这个面目可怖的丛林显得和善了起来：意识强度达到20以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_MianJuLevel_20

schinese.description: 更多的同伴与资源，更好的武器与甲胄使你可以吃得更饱，走的更远：意识强度达到30以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_MianJuLevel_30

schinese.description: 如果旅途中没有障碍，还有什么可做的呢；如果遇到了障碍，那就用铁与血来扫清吧：意识强度达到40以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_MianJuLevel_40

schinese.description: 曾经的繁荣消散于亘古时光，崭新的文明矗立于废墟之上：意识强度达到50以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_MianJuLevel_50

schinese.description: 除了自身，这里大概已经没有什么秘密可言了吧：意识强度达到60以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_MianJuLevel_60

schinese.description: “嘘！看到那些齐断的巨木了吗，小心它的爪子，记得翻滚躲开，要快！”：击败凶猛刃齿兽以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JianChiHu01

schinese.description: “阁下什么骨头能硬过这头凶猛猫科的脑袋？呃。。。没有冒犯的意思，我是说起码需要一把青铜武器，比你个头还大的那种”：击败狂暴刃齿兽以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JianChiHu02

schinese.description: “冲冲冲”：击败毁灭刃齿兽以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JianChiHu03

schinese.description: “带好抗毒药剂，我可不想在恶心的脓液里扒拉你脆弱的头盖骨”：击败剧毒鬼雾蛙以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_MGW01

schinese.description: “臌胀的水袋怕什么？当然怕刺咯！听过我建议的小猫咪们现在还有九条命”：击败狂暴鬼雾蛙以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_MGW02

schinese.description: “冲冲冲”：击败毁灭鬼雾蛙以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_MGW03

schinese.description: “他长得高，跳得远，力气还大。逃跑怕是都跑不赢，掏出大盾，跟他比一比，谁才是真的硬！”：击败大力金刚猿以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JuYuan01

schinese.description: “合理规划体力才有机会拿到战利品，万一中途体力不支，怕是要被这家伙一屁股坐成烂泥吧”：击败狂暴金刚猿以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JuYuan02

schinese.description: “冲冲冲”：击败毁灭金刚猿以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JuYuan03

schinese.description: “我们的重武器完全奈何不了它，弓箭和投矛倒是发挥了很大的作用”：击败遮天飓风鹫以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JiNiao01

schinese.description: “我就喊着玩的，结果风一停，它真下来了！呜呜呜太吓人了”：击败狂暴飓风鹫以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JiNiao02

schinese.description: “冲冲冲”：击败毁灭飓风鹫以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_JiNiao03

schinese.description: “太太太太...太冷了，有有有...人带..带带...火把吗”:击败泰坦猛犸象以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_MMX01

schinese.description: “这该死的绒衣好重，脱掉算了。天上是什么？彩色的羊驼骑着鸵鸟跳舞。。。呼。。。真暖和啊”:击败狂暴猛犸象以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_MMX02

schinese.description: “冲冲冲”：击败毁灭猛犸象以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_MMX03

schinese.description: “这把破旧的老木弓实在太差劲了，如果换成族长那把，我一定能一箭命中”：击杀一只10级绿色品质猎物以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_ShouLie01

schinese.description: “我们追踪这只野兽二十多天，今天终于等到机会，你看这块没有箭孔的皮，那是我的杰作...嗝”：击杀一只20级蓝色珍奇猎物以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_ShouLie02

schinese.description: “玉米粉明天就吃完了，算起来它也快出来觅食了，时间刚好”：击杀一只30级紫色无双猎物以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_ShouLie03

schinese.description: “我进过无数次密林，遇见这种猎物的次数，一只手就能数的过来，我要把它挂在我的火坑旁边”：击杀一只40级橙色传说猎物以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_ShouLie04

schinese.description: “二十年前偶遇它，我失去了兄弟。十年前找到它，我失去了眼睛。这一次，既分高下，亦决生死！”：击杀一只50级红色神话猎物以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_ShouLie05

schinese.description: “看着这些孩子拉弓的模样，我总会想起我的大儿子”：击杀一只60级红色神话猎物以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_ShouLie06

schinese.description: 胆怯且不易从地面接近，却是最易获取的食材，只需要最简单的烹饪技巧：击杀10只火鸡以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_Zhu_10

schinese.description: 血腥的危机在灌丛中蔓延，荧荧的绿光于夜色中远缀：击杀10只丛林豹以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_Lang_10

schinese.description: 这些大家伙身上插满了长矛，像惊慌的豪猪一样左冲右突：击杀10只巨象以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_DaXiang_10

schinese.description: 荒原的夜凛冽无星，猫科的爪锋锐绝情：击杀10只荒狮以解锁此旅途里程碑
schinese.name: BP_ChengJiu_Kill_HuangShi_10
